repos_data.description: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.
The platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing

LangChain4j is an idiomatic, open-source Java library for building LLM-powered applications on the JVM. It offers a unified API over popular LLM providers and vector stores, and makes implementing tool calling (including MCP support), agents and RAG easy. It integrates seamlessly with enterprise Java frameworks like Quarkus and Spring Boot.
Regression testing for AI agents. Snapshot behavior,diff tool calls,catch regressions in CI. Works with LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI, Anthropic.
Framework-agnostic evaluation harness for Go — test your MCP servers and AI agents with scored, CI-ready checks.
Open-source, end-to-end platform for evaluating, observing, and improving LLM and AI agent applications. Tracing · Evals · Simulations · Datasets · Gateway · Guardrails. Self-hostable. Apache 2.0.
The open-source safety layer for AI agents — block unsafe tool calls, require approval, enforce budgets, audit, replay.
General Purpose Evaluation and Simulation Environment for all your AI related Workflows
A curated list of awesome frameworks, libraries and software for the Java programming language.
MCP server and typed SDK for the VerifyAX agent-evaluation platform.

Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI. Compare performance of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Simple declarative configs with command line and CI/CD integration.  Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.
